subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the highlighted word.

The policies of the school __***proscribe ***__accessing social media websites on school computers.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Prohibit**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"proscribe"** means to forbid or prohibit something, especially by law or authority. (प्रतिबंधित करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The government proscribes certain substances to ensure public safety.
 
 
 
• The word **"prohibit"** refers to stopping or forbidding something officially or by authority. (निषेध करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The school prohibits the use of mobile phones during class hours.
 
 
 
• Hence, "prohibit" is the synonym of "proscribe" as they both convey the idea of forbidding something.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Prohibit**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vary** (भिन्न होना): To differ or change in size, amount, or degree.

 
 
• **Example:** The prices of groceries vary from one store to another.
 
 
 
• **Reveal** (प्रकट करना): To make something known or visible.
 
 
• **Example:** The investigation revealed critical information about the case.
 
 
 
• **Surround** (घेरना): To enclose or encircle something completely.
 
 
• **Example:** The castle is surrounded by a beautiful garden.
 
 

30:Tb31,

The correct answer is: **Option 3.**
